facts.fact: For e-commerce, a 7-14 day retargeting window is suggested for impulse purchases, and up to 30 days for higher-ticket items.
facts.quote: Use a 7-14 day retargeting window for impulse purchases, up to 30 days for higher-ticket items

facts.fact: For service businesses, 14-30 day retargeting windows are suggested as working well.
facts.quote: 14-30 day windows work well since purchase decisions take longer

facts.fact: For B2B or high-consideration products, 30-90 day retargeting windows are suggested due to longer sales cycles.
facts.quote: B2B or high-consideration:** 30-90 day windows, since sales cycles are longer

facts.fact: A 30-day retargeting window is the recommended starting point before adjusting based on results.
facts.quote: Start with a 30-day window and adjust based on your results.

facts.fact: For display and social retargeting, 3-5 impressions per week is suggested as a reasonable frequency cap starting point.
facts.quote: For display and social, 3-5 impressions per week is a reasonable starting point.

facts.fact: For CTV retargeting, 2-3 impressions per week is suggested as a frequency cap.
facts.quote: For CTV, 2-3 impressions per week keeps you memorable without being annoying.

facts.fact: The guide recommends choosing 1-2 retargeting channels that match where the target audience spends time.
facts.quote: Pick 1-2 channels that match where your audience spends time.

facts.fact: The page advises small businesses to start retargeting with $5-10 per day on one platform.
facts.quote: Begin with $5-10 per day on one platform.

facts.fact: The page recommends creating 3-4 variations of retargeting ads and rotating them to reduce ad fatigue.
facts.quote: Create 3-4 variations of your retargeting ads and rotate them.

facts.fact: According to the vendor Adwave, new CTV ads can be created from any URL in about two minutes.
facts.quote: in about two minutes, making it easy to keep your creative fresh.
